parts.text: In the Name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.

Lord Jesus Christ, You have destroyed the power of death and given the hope of eternal life for body and soul. You granted Your Mother a special place in your glory, and did not allow decay to touch her body. As we rejoice in the Assumption of Mary, grant us renewed confidence in the victory of life over death. Amen. Holy Queen, I rejoice in your Assumption to Heaven. After your life of love and suffering on earth, God took you to be with Him in glory forever. Through your Assumption, help me to overcome sin and become the saint that God has made me to be. Impress upon me the truth that death is the gateway to eternal life with your Son, and that at the Resurrection my body and soul shall reunite and be glorified in the unalloyed joy of Heaven. Until that great day, while on my pilgrimage of life, I ask for your powerful intercession in this novena, especially for, Pause here to mention your request. When I face the hour of my death, be my intercessor and mother before Jesus, that He may bring me to that ineffable banquet with you in the Beatific Vision.
O Queen Assumed into Heaven, pray for us. Amen
In the Name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.

blocks.title: Days 1-9

fragments.text:
Our Father, who art in heaven, hallowed be thy name.
Thy kingdom come, thy will be done, on earth as it is in heaven.
Give us this day our daily bread, and forgive us our trespasses,
as we forgive those who trespass against us.
And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil. Amen.
fragments.title: Our Father

fragments.text:
Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee.
Blessed art thou among women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus.
Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen.
fragments.title: Hail Mary

fragments.text:
Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit.
As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.
fragments.title: Glory Be
